# What the openapi: plugin writes is stored behind the document it read, so a
# second check reads the package from the store and runs nothing, the notes
# included, and an edit to the document writes it again.
env SNGL_GENCACHE_DIR=$WORK/store

sngl check --debug app.sngl
! stderr 'gencache hit" req="sngl.scheme'
stderr 'field loose of Thing is left out'

sngl check --debug app.sngl
stderr 'gencache hit" req="sngl.scheme'
stderr 'field loose of Thing is left out'

# The program reads a field only the edited document declares.
! sngl check named.sngl
stderr 'no field "name" on struct Thing'
cp api2.yml api.yml
sngl check --debug named.sngl
! stderr 'gencache hit" req="sngl.scheme'
! stderr 'field loose of Thing is left out'

-- app.sngl --
import api "openapi:./api.yml"

func idOf(t api.Thing) int {
    return t.id
}
-- named.sngl --
import api "openapi:./api.yml"

func nameOf(t api.Thing) string {
    return t.name
}
-- api.yml --
openapi: 3.1.0
info: {title: T, version: "1"}
paths: {}
components:
  schemas:
    Thing:
      type: object
      required: [id]
      properties:
        id: {type: integer}
        loose: {type: object, additionalProperties: {}}
-- api2.yml --
openapi: 3.1.0
info: {title: T, version: "1"}
paths: {}
components:
  schemas:
    Thing:
      type: object
      required: [id, name]
      properties:
        id: {type: integer}
        name: {type: string}
